scope: Existing search and read-only candidate selection, including implemented WPF goods/unit inputs; no native business migration is implied

rules.matching: Distinct case-insensitive whitespace terms; AND between terms and OR across the fields authorized for that workflow; percent/underscore/backslash remain literal; no AI, pinyin or synonym inference
rules.ordering: Preserve each workflow's authoritative relevance/business priority and stable identity tie-breakers before pagination
rules.identity: Employee, user principal, historical audit actor and visitor identities keep their owning contracts; never infer identities from names or codes
rules.pagination: Initial and search reads publish a bounded page; explicit continuation keeps selected identities independently; empty nonterminal or inconsistent pages are errors rather than successful empty results
rules.retirement: Raw input and identity/server/read-scope changes retire obsolete reads; incomplete IME text does not dispatch; only genuinely pending identical searches are coalesced; completed same-query Enter may refresh
rules.businessAuthority: Permissions, price/cost masks, purpose/status/department eligibility, source facts, drafts, unknown writes and server decisions are unchanged
rules.history: Only current authoritative organization nodes expand a subtree; unmatched historical department IDs retain exact membership without reopening a deleted hierarchy
rules.nativeScopeComposition: Search input changes must compose with the main-line ReadScopeRevisionState, including business-applications and employee department approvals; native business write surfaces remain unported unless separately accepted

interpretation: Samples describe the shared contract. Native inputs forward text to the authoritative server rather than implementing a second matcher. This contract is not proof of completed native ERP workflows or Win7 target-PC acceptance.
